messages:
maria: quick sync  we've seen probe storms after budget penalties kick in. The deprioritized tenants still cause cross-region probes and noise. Need a small, auditable change: quota + hysteresis + fairness matrix.

eli: agree. Two goals: (1) prevent deprioritization from amplifying probes, (2) keep occasional safety probes so regressions don't go silent. Proposal: per-tenant-region token bucket + hysteresis window that grows on repeated suppressions.

sam: sketch of rules: small quotas for low-tier, larger for enterprise; hysteresis doubles backoff_ttl on each suppression up to cap; background "recovery sweep" runs weekly ignoring quotas.

viv: DSL-ish sketch: 
```policy
tenant_defaults {
  probe_tokens_per_min = 10
  backoff_ttl = 30s
  backoff_max = 30m
}
match tenant.tier == "enterprise" {
  probe_tokens_per_min = 300
}
```
This keeps it simple and overridable per-tenant.

eli: also add a tiny fairness matrix: allocate leftover cluster_probe_budget proportional to tenant_tier weight every minute so small bursts can be absorbed but no single deprioritized tenant spikes.

maria: telemetry: probes_allowed, probes_suppressed, backoff_count per tenant-region. Alert if suppressed_probes for high-traffic tenant > 5m. Dashboard tile: suppressed_vs_fired by tenant.

sam: boundary/API: policy-engine returns flat probe_hint: "allowed" (bool), "remaining_tokens" (int), "backoff_ttl" (seconds). Probe-manager enforces token bucket locally. Keep shape stable.

ops-bot: deploybot: Canary window suggested 2026-06-01 01:00-05:00 UTC. Remember to bump config schema when adding probe_hint fields.

viv: rollback plan: runtime toggle to disable quota enforcement -> revert policy config -> run immediate full-health sweep to re-warm caches. Also keep an automated small-scale checker that runs if probe suppression spikes.

eli: testing: unit tests for token logic + hysteresis, integration sim with 100k reqs across two regions, chaos test with partitioned token caches. Staging rollout 1% -> 10% -> 50%, exclude enterprise.

maria: decision: lean +1 for token-bucket + hysteresis + fairness matrix + recovery sweep + probe_hint API. I'll draft RFC with DSL, probe_hint wire sample, telemetry & runbook. Ping this thread when PR is up.

sam: will review tests and sim harness.

ops-bot: deploybot: Note: policy-manager hotreload idempotent but config_version must increment when adding probe_hint fields.
